mechanism: Higher funded defense budgets and stockpile replenishment can become missile, air-defense, naval, sensor, and engine awards that RTX converts through qualified production, deliveries, and sustainment into revenue, segment profit, cash flow, and backlog; shareholder transmission depends on pricing, productivity, mix, fixed-price execution, suppliers, export approvals, commercial aerospace, Pratt remediation, leverage, and valuation.
catalyst: Funded missile, air-defense, naval, sensor, and engine awards lift qualified output; defense backlog converts into deliveries; Raytheon margins and group free cash flow improve; Pratt remediation costs decline; and inventory, receivables, contract assets, and fixed-price provisions remain controlled while capacity expands.
invalidation: Defense budgets fail to become funded awards; replenishment urgency fades; export approvals or supplier constraints prevent delivery; production expansion creates quality failures; fixed-price charges absorb volume; commercial aerospace declines; Pratt remediation liabilities rise; leverage constrains capital allocation; or defense growth fails to produce sustained group-level free cash flow.

mechanism: Geopolitical intrusion, cloud and identity complexity, and regulatory accountability raise continuity and compliance demand; CrowdStrike can convert that demand through Falcon subscriptions and multi-module adoption into ARR, revenue, and cash flow, subject to competition, platform bundling, incident trust, renewal quality, GAAP costs, stock-based compensation, dilution, and valuation.
catalyst: Fiscal Q2 and later primary evidence shows durable net-new ARR and retention, broader paid module adoption, improving GAAP operating margin, continued cash conversion after incident costs, declining stock compensation per share, and preserved pricing and trust against bundled alternatives.
invalidation: Net-new ARR or retention deteriorates; module adoption reflects discounting rather than wallet-share gains; customers consolidate into lower-cost bundles; a product or service failure causes lasting trust and renewal damage; incident liabilities persist; cash conversion depends on working-capital timing; or weak GAAP economics, equity awards, and acquisitions prevent per-share cash compounding.

mechanism: Anduril can buy Palantir Warp Speed software and participate with Palantir in defence programs such as TITAN, so growth in Anduril's product-company model could create software demand or program pull-through for Palantir; however, no current source quantifies Anduril-derived Palantir revenue, margin, contract duration, concentration, or incremental cash flow, and Anduril's separate Army procurement ceiling is neither obligated nor Palantir revenue.
catalyst: Palantir discloses material Anduril-derived revenue, contract duration, software attachment, margins, or cash flow; Anduril production awards produce measurable recurring Warp Speed demand; or joint defence programs award Palantir identifiable economics that are material relative to its broader business.
invalidation: Anduril internalizes the relevant software stack, selects competing infrastructure, joint programs do not award Palantir material economics, Warp Speed remains an immaterial customer relationship, or Palantir continues to omit Anduril exposure because it is not financially material.

mechanism: Government and commercial demand for launches, spacecraft, components, and mission systems can flow directly into Rocket Lab's Launch Services and Space Systems revenue and backlog; shareholder benefit depends on reliable missions, profitable contract conversion, lower cash use, and disciplined financing.
catalyst: Electron cadence and mission reliability remain durable, backlog converts at maintained margins, Space Systems repeat-program revenue expands, Neutron reaches milestones without material overruns, customer concentration declines, and operating cash use falls without repeated equity issuance.
invalidation: Launch or mission failures interrupt cadence, Neutron slips or exceeds budget, customers terminate or modify material backlog, fixed-price contracts generate losses, concentration rises, segment revenue decouples from sector demand, or cash burn requires dilution that outruns enterprise-value growth.

mechanism: Adoption and utilization of Intuitive's robotically assisted procedure systems expand the installed base and directly drive procedure-linked instruments, accessories, and service revenue; shareholder benefit depends on recurring-revenue growth converting through operating margin, safety, training quality, hospital economics, and cash.
catalyst: Procedure and installed-base growth remains durable, da Vinci 5 and Ion utilization expands, recurring instruments and service revenue grows, and operating margin remains resilient after tariffs and supply costs.
invalidation: Procedure utilization or installed-base growth stalls, recurring revenue decouples from adoption, hospital budgets defer placements, safety or training evidence weakens, reimbursement or regulation constrains use, competition erodes returns, or tariffs and supply constraints prevent cash conversion.

mechanism: Structural copper scarcity can raise Rio Tinto's realized copper economics, margins, reserve value, and returns on funded copper growth through Oyu Tolgoi and its other copper assets; shareholder transmission depends on attributable volumes and free cash flow after costs, taxes, ownership interests, capex, leverage, iron ore, aluminium, lithium, and other portfolio demands.
catalyst: Oyu Tolgoi volume and cost improvements convert into attributable segment and group free cash flow, copper guidance and project schedules hold, net debt remains controlled, Winu or Resolution advances without undermining returns, and the half-year results show a larger copper contribution to group cash generation.
invalidation: New supply, recycling, substitution, or weaker demand removes scarcity; Oyu Tolgoi or other copper projects slip; grades, recoveries, water, costs, taxes, or ownership terms worsen; group copper output or attributable cash flow fails to rise; or iron-ore weakness, acquisitions, capex, leverage, and other portfolio demands absorb copper gains.

mechanism: Nearshoring and friendshoring can increase demand for locally compliant flat steel; Ternium's Pesquería downstream lines and DRI-EAF shop can convert that demand into Mexican shipments, utilization, revenue, margins, and ADS-holder earnings, subject to commissioning, customer qualification, trade rules, steel pricing, cash conversion, and non-Mexican exposures.
catalyst: Downstream lines achieve disclosed utilization and customer qualification, the DRI-EAF shop commissions on the revised early-2027 schedule without material cost escalation, USMCA review outcomes preserve workable regional rules, Mexican shipments and margins rise, and operating cash flow covers remaining capex while attributable earnings improve.
invalidation: USMCA or tariff changes fragment regional supply chains; customers do not qualify or use Pesquería output; startup slips again; infrastructure constraints impede utilization; imports or weak demand depress steel pricing; or working capital, capex, Usiminas commitments, currencies, minority interests, and non-Mexican operations absorb the regional benefit.

mechanism: EV and stationary-storage demand plus constrained supply can support lithium-concentrate prices and volumes, increasing Sigma Lithium's revenue, mine utilization, margins, cash generation, and expansion option value; shareholder benefit depends on production stability, receivable collection, liquidity, debt and offtake obligations, controls, environmental status, Phase 2 funding, and commodity cyclicality.
catalyst: Lithium-concentrate demand and realized pricing remain durable, production and recovery stay stable, receivables convert to cash, operating cash flow turns positive, debt and offtake obligations remain serviceable, Phase 2 obtains committed non-dilutive funding, and controls and environmental matters are remediated.
invalidation: Supply restarts, new projects, recycling, sodium-ion adoption, material efficiency, or weaker demand restores surplus; realized pricing or volumes fall; output or recovery remains unstable; receivables do not convert; debt, prepayment, supplier, or environmental constraints impair operations; Phase 2 requires deeply dilutive funding; or lithium ceases to provide positive operating leverage.

mechanism: Sovereign procurement preferences can redirect demand toward qualified European and allied small-UAS suppliers; Parrot can convert that demand through ANAFI UKR production and institutional sales into revenue, gross profit, and cash flow, subject to award value, customer concentration, component provenance, supply constraints, operating costs, working capital, and dilution-aware valuation.
catalyst: The July 31 half-year release confirms sustained institutional micro-UAV growth, named or measurable order conversion, customer diversification, auditable allied-component content, stable or improving gross margin, and positive operating cash flow without heavier use of the shareholder facility; further trusted-procurement qualifications broaden demand access.
invalidation: Institutional awards remain immaterial or concentrated; trusted-source qualifications or component provenance cannot be substantiated; Chinese dependencies remain critical; component constraints delay delivery; rapid redesign and price compression erode margins; inventory and receivables consume cash; or micro-UAV growth fails to produce durable operating profit and cash flow.

mechanism: Lithium demand and tighter supply can raise Albemarle's realized Energy Storage prices, volumes, margins, operating cash flow, and resource option value; shareholder benefit depends on contract lags, costs, inventory timing, capex, taxes, leverage, supply response, and dilution.
catalyst: EV and storage demand remains durable, realized prices and volumes stay higher after contract lags, Energy Storage margins and operating cash flow remain positive without favorable inventory timing, capex stays disciplined, leverage falls through operations, and Q2 evidence confirms the recovery.
invalidation: Supply restarts, new projects, recycling, sodium-ion adoption, material efficiency, or weaker demand restores surplus; realized prices fail to follow benchmarks; volumes or margins weaken; working capital consumes cash; capex, taxes, debt, or dilution absorb operating gains; or Energy Storage economics decouple from the lithium cycle.

mechanism: Higher-density compute requires switchgear, power distribution, power quality, thermal management, and related electrical infrastructure; Eaton can convert data-centre and grid demand through qualified Electrical Americas and Electrical Global products into orders, backlog, revenue, segment profit, and cash flow, subject to customer concentration, project delays, capacity execution, acquisitions, leverage, working capital, order normalization, and valuation.
catalyst: Q2 and later primary evidence shows broad data-centre and utility orders, electrical backlog converting into revenue, durable margins and operating cash flow, capacity additions earning acceptable returns, controlled customer concentration, and acquisition integration reducing leverage without higher working-capital intensity.
invalidation: Data-centre projects are cancelled or delayed; efficiency or architecture changes reduce Eaton content; customers internalize or dual-source equipment; capacity additions cause price or utilization deterioration; electrical orders fail to become revenue and cash; acquisitions miss returns; leverage constrains capital allocation; or concentration drives sustained margin compression.

mechanism: EV and stationary-storage demand plus constrained supply can raise SQM's realized lithium prices, volumes, gross profit, earnings, cash generation, and resource option value; ADS-holder benefit depends on Chilean partnership attribution and state take, contract pricing, permits, conversion ramp, capex, minority interests, debt, and commodity cyclicality.
catalyst: EV and stationary-storage demand remains durable, realized lithium prices and volumes stay higher, earnings convert to cash after Chilean state payments, tax, and capex, Kwinana approaches nameplate, Salar Futuro permitting advances, debt remains controlled, and Q2 primary evidence confirms the recovery.
invalidation: Supply restarts, new projects, recycling, sodium-ion adoption, material efficiency, or weaker demand restores surplus; realized prices or volumes reverse; Chilean partnership economics or state take worsens; Salar Futuro or Australian conversion slips; capex, tax, debt, or minority interests absorb operating gains; or lithium ceases to be financially material to SQM.

mechanism: Structural copper scarcity can raise Southern Copper's realized copper revenue, mine margins, operating cash flow, reserve value, and returns on funded growth; shareholder transmission depends on production, grades, recoveries, by-product credits, costs, taxes, project spending, jurisdictional terms, and capital allocation.
catalyst: Copper pricing remains supportive while grades and recoveries improve, production returns to growth, cash costs remain competitive without exceptional by-product credits, operating cash flow funds capital investment and prudent distributions, and Tía María and other projects advance without undermining returns.
invalidation: New supply, recycling, substitution, or weaker demand removes scarcity; grades or recoveries remain weak; production fails to recover; costs, taxes, royalties, water, labor, or jurisdictional terms worsen; projects are delayed or overrun; by-product credits normalize sharply; or attributable free cash flow fails to rise with realized copper prices.

mechanism: Recursion applies computational models, biological data, and automated experimentation to identify and advance drug candidates; repeatable gains in target selection, cycle time, or clinical translation can create pipeline and partner value, but common-share benefit depends on trial success, partner economics, operating burn, capital needs, and dilution.
catalyst: Blinded clinical data support efficacy and safety, FDA engagement produces clear development paths, REC-4881 and REC-1245 advance, partner milestones become repeatable, measured discovery-cycle or probability-of-success improvements are disclosed, and operating burn declines without financing that overwhelms per-share value.
invalidation: Programs fail safety or efficacy tests; development time or cost does not improve; candidates are repeatedly deprioritized; partnership revenue remains immaterial; proprietary-data commitments consume capital without measurable output; or financing and dilution absorb the platform value attributable to existing common shares.

mechanism: Durable EV and stationary-storage lithium demand plus delayed supply can improve expected lithium pricing, Thacker Pass operating economics, construction funding, offtake value, and the project option value attributable to Lithium Americas common shares; transmission depends on 62% ownership, remaining capex, DOE and GM terms, warrants, dilution, schedule, commissioning, and product qualification.
catalyst: EV and storage demand remains durable, lithium-price and offtake economics support Thacker Pass, construction remains within disclosed cost and schedule, funding conditions are satisfied, dilution stays bounded, late-2027 mechanical completion is achieved, and qualified battery-grade production advances toward the planned 2028 ramp.
invalidation: Supply restarts, new projects, recycling, sodium-ion adoption, material efficiency, or weaker demand restores durable surplus; lithium prices cease to support Thacker Pass economics; capex rises materially; funding conditions fail; construction, commissioning, or qualification slips; offtake economics disappoint; or dilution and encumbering claims transfer project value away from existing common shareholders.

mechanism: Growth in industrial robotics and embodied AI can increase demand for robot controllers, drives, motors, machine automation, engineering software, and lifecycle service that ABB historically could convert into revenue, margin, and cash flow; however, ABB has agreed to divest Robotics, expects the net proceeds in the second half of 2026, and does not disclose material recurring RobotStudio or humanoid-attributable economics, so the common shares do not provide a durable direct transmission channel for this idea.
catalyst: Reconsider only if the Robotics divestment does not close, ABB retains material participation in Robotics economics, or retained automation and actuator businesses disclose material embodied-AI design wins, recurring software or service revenue, margins, and cash flow attributable to scaled deployments.
invalidation: The Robotics divestment closes without material retained economics, humanoid deployments remain pilots, retained ABB businesses do not disclose material embodied-AI revenue or cash flow, fixed automation or competing suppliers capture the demand, or post-sale capital is redeployed into businesses whose economics are not driven by this idea.

mechanism: AI models trained on Recursion's biological and chemical data, coupled with automated wet-lab experiments, can shorten candidate-selection loops and generate proprietary drug programs; Recursion can capture value through owned-pipeline economics and partner milestones only if candidates survive clinical and regulatory validation and the resulting value exceeds operating burn, data commitments, financing, and dilution.
catalyst: Blinded REC-4881 efficacy and safety data, further REC-1245 dose-escalation evidence, clear FDA development paths, repeatable partner milestones, disclosed improvements in discovery cycle time or success rates, and operating burn below guidance without financing that overwhelms per-share value.
invalidation: Platform-derived programs fail safety or efficacy tests; discovery timelines, costs, or clinical success do not improve versus relevant baselines; candidates are repeatedly deprioritized; partnership economics remain immaterial; pharma internalizes the workflow; data obligations consume capital without measurable output; or financing and dilution absorb the platform's enterprise value.

mechanism: Rising data-centre electricity demand and grid constraints increase demand for generation equipment, services, and electrification systems; GE Vernova can convert that demand through Power and Electrification into orders, backlog, revenue, margins, and cash flow, subject to project schedules, customer concentration, backlog quality, working-capital normalization, Wind execution, capacity investment, acquisition integration, and valuation.
catalyst: Later primary evidence shows broad Power and Electrification orders, data-centre and utility projects proceeding on schedule, backlog converting into revenue, durable service mix and margins, normalized free cash flow, acceptable returns on capacity investment, and controlled customer concentration and cancellations.
invalidation: Data-centre or utility projects are cancelled or delayed; efficiency or architecture changes reduce power-equipment demand; competing supply or internal generation weakens GE Vernova content; capacity expansion causes price or utilization deterioration; orders fail to become revenue and normalized cash; Wind, warranties, tariffs, acquisitions, or capacity projects absorb gains; customer concentration rises; or backlog materially corrects.

mechanism: Creator content and discovery can increase Roblox users, hours, payer activity, bookings, revenue, and cash flow; shareholder benefit depends on safety and trust, creator and infrastructure costs, cohort durability, cash conversion, and dilution discipline.
catalyst: Post-age-check engagement and acquisition stabilize, payer and older-user growth remain durable, long-tail content keeps gaining share, advertising and subscriptions add monetization, creator earnings expand with sustainable platform economics, and free cash flow per diluted share grows.
invalidation: Safety or regulatory failures impair trust; age controls cause enduring acquisition or retention declines; attention fragments; content concentration rises; bookings or payer growth decouple from engagement; creator, distribution, infrastructure or moderation costs absorb revenue; deferred-revenue timing dominates cash generation; or dilution outruns per-share cash-flow growth.

mechanism: Structural copper scarcity can raise Freeport-McMoRan's realized copper prices, mine margins, operating cash flow, and reserve option value; shareholder benefit depends on attributable production, unit costs, capital spending, minority interests, safety, and Indonesian operating terms.
catalyst: Copper pricing remains supported while safe Grasberg restoration, Americas leach initiatives and brownfield projects lift attributable sales, unit costs remain controlled, operating cash flow exceeds capital needs, and final Indonesian rights preserve common-share value.
invalidation: New supply, recycling, substitution or weaker demand removes scarcity; production recovery stalls; costs or capex absorb pricing gains; Indonesian terms worsen; safety incidents recur; or attributable free cash flow fails to rise with realized copper prices.

mechanism: Scaling AI training and inference increases demand for low-latency, high-throughput data-centre fabrics; Arista can convert that demand through Ethernet switching and routing products, EOS software, and related services into revenue, gross profit, and cash flow, subject to customer concentration, architecture substitution, qualification, supply, inventory, purchase commitments, and valuation.
catalyst: Q2 and later primary evidence shows durable cloud and AI networking growth, explicit AI-network revenue progression, maintained margins and cash conversion, successful 1.6T qualification, customer diversification, and inventory and purchase commitments aligned with realized demand.
invalidation: Ethernet loses material AI-fabric share; major customers internalize networking; aggregate AI capex stops reaching Arista revenue; qualification or acceptance slows; merchant-silicon or supply constraints impair launches; purchase commitments become excess inventory; or concentration drives sustained margin and cash-flow deterioration.

mechanism: Clearer rules and broader adoption can increase regulated trading, custody, stablecoin balances, payments, financing, and on-chain activity; Coinbase can monetize those flows through transaction fees, stablecoin revenue, subscriptions and services, institutional products, custody, and Base, subject to crypto-cycle, rate, partner-term, take-rate, counterparty, custody, cyber, regulatory, stock-compensation, dilution, and valuation risks.
catalyst: Q2 and later primary evidence shows stablecoin balances and non-speculative payment usage growing despite lower rates, recurring subscription and custody revenue expanding, resilient transaction share, durable GAAP cash earnings through a crypto drawdown, lower counterparty concentration, strong custody controls, and dilution-adjusted cash generation.
invalidation: Adoption remains predominantly speculative; crypto activity contracts without resilient recurring revenue; lower rates or adverse partner terms overwhelm stablecoin balance growth; competitors capture the economics; fees compress structurally; a material custody, cyber, credit, or regulatory loss occurs; or stock-based compensation and dilution prevent operating growth from reaching shareholders.

mechanism: Electric-load growth, data-centre construction, utility capital expenditure, and grid constraints increase demand for Atkore electrical raceway, conduit, and cable-management products; shareholder benefit depends on pricing catching input costs and volume converting to free cash flow.
catalyst: Electrical volume remains positive while pricing catches input inflation, segment margin recovers, and operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
invalidation: Electrical demand fails to produce segment volume or input costs, competition, project delays, and working capital prevent adequate margin and free-cash-flow conversion.

mechanism: A recovery in residential solar financing, installer health, channel inventory, and storage adoption directly raises demand for Enphase microinverters, batteries, gateways, and energy-management software; shareholder benefit depends on margin, cash, warranty, tariff, and policy quality.
catalyst: US sell-through stabilises without inventory growth, battery shipments recover, tariff-adjusted margin holds, and normalised free cash flow remains positive.
invalidation: Financing and lost incentives keep demand structurally lower, inventory requires discounting, safe-harbour commitments do not become installations, or tariffs, warranties, and purchase obligations impair returns and cash.

mechanism: Load growth, renewable penetration, grid congestion, and reliability needs increase demand for Fluence storage systems, services, and optimization software; shareholder benefit depends on project margin, working-capital, warranty, and financing conversion.
catalyst: Backlog converts at stable or rising normalized gross margin, adjusted EBITDA guidance is delivered, and operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
invalidation: Storage deployment or backlog weakens, project costs and competition compress margins, working capital remains structurally negative, warranties or trade rules raise costs, or financing dilutes returns.
